hint: `a ^ b` adds bit positions without carrying; `(a & b) << 1` is the carry. Repeat until there is no carry left. Because Python integers are unbounded, negatives are handled by masking to 32-bit two's complement so the carry terminates and the sign is reconstructed from the top bit. Examples: add(5, 3) -> 8 add(0, 0) -> 0 add(7, 0) -> 7 add(-3, 5) -> 2 add(-4, -6) -> -10
